model_output.rationale: Lines 0 and 2 paid normally (CO-45 write-off + PR-2 coinsurance). Line 1 (97110) is denied CO-236 + N20 — NCCI PTP edit. 97110 has no bypass modifier; 97112 on line 0 already carries 59. The chart note documents a separate session for 97110. Whether a modifier can be appended turns entirely on the CCMI for the 97110 pair in the Q3 2026 PTP edit file — CCMI=1 → correct_and_resubmit (reopening + modifier); CCMI=0 → do_not_resubmit. The 835 carries neither the partner code nor the CCMI.

awaiting_human.question: What is the CCMI (Column-to-Column Modifier Indicator) for the 97110 PTP pair — 97110 vs 97112 and/or 97110 vs 97150 — in the CMS NCCI PTP edit file effective Q3 2026 (July 1, 2026)?
awaiting_human.why_needed: CCMI=1 allows a bypass modifier and routes to correct_and_resubmit (clerical-error reopening, Medicare Part B); CCMI=0 means the edit is absolute and the action is do_not_resubmit. The chart note supports a separate-session defense but that is only relevant if CCMI=1.
